 "data": "---
title: Agentic Quant Pairs-Trading Architecture
config:
 layout: elk
---
flowchart TD
 subgraph DS[\"Data Sources\"]
 A1[\"Yahoo Finance API\"]
 A2[\"SEC EDGAR / Transcripts\"]
 end

 subgraph SL[\"Storage Layer\"]
 B1[\"ETL Pipeline\"]
 B2[\"Ingestion & Chunking\"]
 C1[(\"Parquet Files\")]
 C2[(\"Qdrant Vector DB\")]
 end

 subgraph QE[\"Quant Engine\"]
 D1[\"Engle-Granger Cointegration\"]
 D2[\"Z-Score Spread Signals<br>(~18k Entries)\"]
 end

 subgraph AG[\"Agentic Risk Gatekeeper\"]
 E1{\"7-Day Pre-Filter Check\"}
 E2[\"Bypass LLM:<br>Default GO\"]
 E3[\"LLM Agent Evaluator\"]
 E4[\"Stochastic Path Simulation\"]
 end

 subgraph SV[\"Serving Layer\"]
 F[\"FastAPI Backend Endpoints\"]
 G[\"Execution / Backtest Engine\"]
 end

 A1 -->|\"Historical Prices\"| B1
 A2 -->|\"Qualitative Docs\"| B2
 B1 -->|\"Clean Panel Data\"| C1
 B2 -->|\"Embeddings & Payload\"| C2
 C1 --> D1
 D1 --> D2
 D2 --> E1
 E1 -->|\"No Recent Filing\"| E2
 E1 -->|\"Recent Filing Found\"| E3
 E3 -->|\"Tool Call: Vector Search\"| C2
 E3 -->|\"Tool Call: Monte Carlo\"| E4
 E2 --> F
 E3 --> F
 F --> G

 classDef source fill:#ffe6cc,stroke:#d79b00
 classDef step fill:#dae8fc,stroke:#6c8ebf
 classDef decision fill:#fff2cc,stroke:#d6b656
 classDef store fill:#e1d5e7,stroke:#9673a6
 classDef output fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366

 class A1,A2 source
 class B1,B2,D1,D2,E3,E4 step
 class E1 decision
 class C1,C2 store
 class E2,F,G output",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
